title: nsevt: Honest non-stationary extreme-value tail risk
description: A small, dependency-light Python package for the honest analysis of trends in environmental extremes: bounded-tail detection (peaks-over-threshold GPD with profile-likelihood shape intervals and a bootstrap of the finite endpoint), a permutation-calibrated tail-scale trend test, Monte-Carlo power and minimum-detectable-effect analysis, multi-source transportability, block-conformal prediction bands valid under temporal dependence, and a two-scale Wasserstein distributional trend test.
